scripts.dev: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node tools/patch_prisma_client.js && concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:win: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node tools/patch_prisma_client.js && concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT,LAUNCH" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:launcher"
scripts.dev:server: nodemon --watch src/server --watch src/shared --watch assets/data -e ts,json --exec "ts-node --project config/tsconfig.json src/server/index.ts" > logs/server.log 2>&1
scripts.build: npx prisma generate && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:prod: node tools/switch_to_postgres.js && npx prisma generate && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.start:prod: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node dist-server/server/index.js
